faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DES Chennai Office Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the DES Chennai Office Assistant recruitment is 18th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum qualification required for the Office Assistant post?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification required for the Office Assistant post is 8th Pass. Additionally, candidates must possess the ability to read and write in Tamil.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Office Assistant position?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Office Assistant position is between 18 years and 34 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Office Assistant post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Office Assistant post will receive a salary in the range of Rs. 15700 to Rs. 58100 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the DES Chennai Office Assistant job?
faq.answer: Applications for the DES Chennai Office Assistant job must be submitted offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it, and send it to the official address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the DES Chennai Office Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the DES Chennai Office Assistant recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Office Assistant post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Office Assistant post primarily involves Document Verification. Candidates will be shortlisted based on the documents submitted.

faq.question: Q8. How many vacancies are available for the Office Assistant post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Office Assistant post in the Department of Economics and Statistics Chennai (DES Chennai).

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website for DES Chennai?
faq.answer: The official website for the Department of Economics and Statistics Chennai (DES Chennai) is https://chennai.nic.in. You can visit this site for more information and updates.

faq.question: Q10. What documents are required to be attached with the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates are required to attach self-attested copies of necessary documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and educational certificates with the application form.
